correctness.rationale: The substitution fixed point satisfies p_2j=0 and p_(2j+1)=1-p_j, forbids 11 and 0000. For n>=4, an equal length-n factor at opposite start parities would force four consecutive zeros, impossible. Equal even starts decimate to equal length-floor(n/2) parent factors; odd starts to length-ceil(n/2). Since R is monotone, earliest new repeated start is min(2R(floor(n/2)),2R(ceil(n/2))+1)=2R(floor(n/2)). Bases R(1..3)=2,3,4 determine the exact dyadic staircase and liminf=1, limsup=3/2. Independent direct byte-factor comparison matched the recurrence for n=1..200; the parity argument proves all positive n.
